# Nexus Clip
> GNOME Shell 50 extension: clipboard → LLM inference pipeline over an OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint (LIFO stack + FIFO of prompts + GTK prompt chooser).

## Core files
- extension/extension.js — Extension subclass, keybindings (S1/S2/S3)
- extension/lib/actions.js — orchestration of S1/S2/S3
- extension/lib/v1client.js — HTTP client: chat() (non-stream) + stream() (SSE)
- extension/lib/v1core.js — PURE: buildMessages/buildPayload/parseCompletion
- extension/lib/sse.js — PURE: SSE parser + incremental UTF-8 decoder
- extension/lib/store.js — PURE: LIFO/FIFO/history persistence (schemaVersion'd)
- extension/lib/selector.js — GTK preset chooser window (+ live response)
- extension/prefs.js — preferences (API / Presets / Hotkeys)
- extension/schemas/org.gnome.shell.extensions.nexus-clip.gschema.xml — GSettings schema
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — architecture, flows, state model, HTTP contract
- docs/DEVELOPMENT.md — build/install/test/smoke workflow
- docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md — failure modes
- docs/adr/ — decision log
- tests/ — node --test (store, v1core, sse)

## Key concepts
- LIFO stack: inputs pushed by S1 (`<Super>c`). Top = newest.
- FIFO: prompts chosen in S2 (`<Super>x`) via the GTK window; consumed one-per-press by S3 (`<Super>v`).
- Active preset: the FIRST key of the `presets` JSON object; used by S1/S2.
- Pure/impure split: logic in pure modules (node --test), GJS/UI thin & validated manually.
- /v1 contract: POST chat/completions (OpenAI-compatible), SSE streaming with `data: [DONE]` terminator.
- GJS/libsoup3: no promisify on send_and_read_async; send_finish() returns Gio.InputStream; TextDecoder has no stream option.
- State: ~/.local/share/nexus-clip-gnome/{stack.json,fifo.json,history.jsonl} (tree-ready via id/parentId).

## Constraints
- GNOME Shell 45–50 (ESM; no imports.gi legacy). Wayland reload (logout/login) needed after install.
- No credentials in the repo (api-key via dconf). No providers other than OpenAI-compatible /v1.
